page.title: Signal Details
page.description: Every carrier the modem uses, live, with trends and distributions over the last minutes. Source: {{source}}.
page.description_aggregated: Every carrier the modem uses, live, with trends and distributions over the last minutes. Source: {{source}} · {{total}} MHz aggregated.

chart_empty.no_samples_tx_power: No {{metric}} samples in this window. TX power is the last PUSCH transmission, kept for 5 s.

trend.title: Trends
trend.description: {{metric}} over the window, PCell against the 5G cell.
trend.description_unit: {{metric}} ({{unit}}) over the window, PCell against the 5G cell.

distribution.title: Distributions
distribution.description: Share of the window's samples in each {{metric}} bin, per radio technology.

carriers.title: Carriers
carriers.description: Every carrier in use, one row each. Colors follow the signal quality ramp; a dash is a value the modem did not report.
carriers.estimated_note: * Band default bandwidth, not yet learnt from the network.

cell.not_measured: Configured by the network, not measured by this firmware.

link_adaptation.tx_last: Last PUSCH transmission, not an average
link_adaptation.tx_none: No PUSCH in the last 5 s

neighbours.title: LTE neighbour cells
neighbours.description: Cells the modem measured in the last 10 s (0xB180), strongest first. Δ is against the serving cell on the same EARFCN, else the PCell.
neighbours.empty_live: No neighbour measurement in the last 10 s.
neighbours.empty_qmi: Needs diag_bridge: QMI does not report neighbour cells.

diag_logs.title: DIAG log coverage
diag_logs.description: {{seen}} of {{total}} subscribed logs received since diag_bridge started. Event-driven ones (RACH, MIB, RRC configuration) only come at attach, handover or reconfiguration.
diag_logs.no_stats: This diag_bridge does not publish log statistics.

feeds.0xB173: LTE DL rate, BLER, modulation, MCS
feeds.0xB139: LTE UL rate, UL RB, UL modulation
feeds.0xB881: NR UL rate, MCS, PRB, PHR, Pcmax

events.title: Radio events
events.description: DIAG events, newest first: the bridge's last 20 when the page opens, then every one while it stays open. State changes, handovers, failures, RACH and carrier aggregation come only when something happens.
events.counters_note: Counters since diag_bridge started; they reset when it restarts.
events.empty_qmi: Needs diag_bridge: QMI does not report events.
events.empty_none: No radio event since this page opened. A stable cell can stay quiet for a long time.
events.empty_category: No event of this category yet.

throughput.aggregate_live: All carriers, counted at the radio layer: includes IPA-offloaded traffic and HARQ retransmissions.
throughput.needs_bridge: Needs diag_bridge: QMI does not report data rates.
throughput.by_carrier_description: How the current rate splits across the carriers, colored by radio technology.
